'''Master of Port Administration''', also called '''Port Administrator''' for short, was the title of local administrators of the [[City/Legends|cities]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]]. Each master acted as a type of [[Mayor/Legends|mayor]] and was assisted by an advisory committee. The Masters of Port Administration each sat on the [[Utapaun Committee/Legends|Utapaun Committee]], run by the [[Chairman of Utapau/Legends|Chairman of Utapau]], the [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]]. Members of the [[Pau'an/Legends|Pau'an]] [[Species/Legends|species]] typically served as Masters of Port Administration, and the roles were often granted based on heritage.<ref name="NEGTAS" />

As of the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], [[Tion Medon/Legends|Tion Medon]] had been Master of Port Administration of [[Pau City/Legends|Pau City]], the planet's [[Capital/Legends|capital]], for over two hundred years, and came from a [[Tion Medon's family|line]] of distinguished Pau'ans who helped shape the planet's history. Presiding over the [[Sinkhole/Legends|sinkhole]] [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] of [[Pau City/Legends|Pau City]], he carried the ornate [[Port master's walking stick]] fashioned from exotic alloy.<ref name="RotS VD">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> Chairman Medon was assisted by his aide, [[Lampay Fay/Legends|Lampay Fay]]. The Administrator personally welcomed [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] to the city, and warned him of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous's]] presence on the [[Level 10/Legends|Tenth Level]].<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref>

[[Telan Medon]] served as Master of Port Administrator in [[138 ABY]].<ref name="Legacy">[[Legacy (2006) 49|''Legacy'' (2006) 49]]</ref>
